name: realism-wave4-curtain-sill
description: Wave 4A — curtain sill standoff A/B in the main orbit scene (all items render regardless of room). One blackout drawn curtain snapped to a window; standoff toggled 0 (before, sill pokes through) vs 0.16 (after, clears).

steps.name: dismiss
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s=window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: pick-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const byId=Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w=>[w.id,w])); const centre=(o)=>{const w=byId[o.wallId];const dx=w.end[0]-w.start[0],dz=w.end[1]-w.start[1];const len=Math.hypot(dx,dz);const t=o.offset+o.width/2;return{id:o.id,cx:w.start[0]+dx/len*t,cz:w.start[1]+dz/len*t,nx:-dz/len,nz:dx/len,width:o.width,sill:o.sill,head:o.head};}; const wins=fp.openings.filter(o=>byId[o.wallId]&&o.kind==='window').map(centre); const ld=fp.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='livingDining')||fp.rooms.reduce((a,r)=>r.width*r.depth>a.width*a.depth?r:a); const rc=[ld.origin[0]+ld.width/2, ld.origin[1]+ld.depth/2]; window.__C=rc; wins.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.cx-rc[0],a.cz-rc[1])-Math.hypot(b.cx-rc[0],b.cz-rc[1])); window.__win=wins[0]; console.log('WIN', JSON.stringify(window.__win), 'RC', JSON.stringify(rc)); })()

steps.name: drop
steps.eval: (function(){ const w=window.__win; const c=window.__C; let ux=c[0]-w.cx,uz=c[1]-w.cz; const l=Math.hypot(ux,uz)||1; ux/=l;uz/=l; window.__inx=ux; window.__inz=uz; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([w.cx+ux*0.4, w.cz+uz*0.4], true); })()

steps.name: frame-before
steps.eval: (function(){ const w=window.__win; const ux=window.__inx,uz=window.__inz; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[w.cx+ux*0.35, 0.3, w.cz+uz*0.35], radius:1.15}); })()

steps.name: frame-wide
steps.eval: (function(){ const w=window.__win; const ux=window.__inx,uz=window.__inz; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[w.cx+ux*0.9, (w.sill||0.4)+0.4, w.cz+uz*0.9], radius:1.7}); })()
